title: Set up project environment and dependencies
description: Initialize the project with Godot 4.5.1 .NET, .NET 8 SDK, and ensure packages.lock.json is present.
acceptance: task-0001.json must include machine-readable fields for godot_version, dotnet_version, packages_lock_exists, and evidence_paths; missing any field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must provide explicit pass/fail conclusions for Windows-only and UTF-8 compliance with traceable evidence sources; vague statements (for example, "checked") fail acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must list all evidence paths for Task 1, and every path must resolve to an existing file under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/; any broken path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

On Windows, GODOT_BIN must be set to the absolute path of the Godot 4.5.1 .NET console executable, and .NET-console flavor must be proven by both executable identity evidence and version-command output captured from that exact path; task-0001.json must record godot_bin_env.env_var_name="GODOT_BIN", godot_bin_env.env_var_value (absolute path), godot_bin_env.env_var_scope (Process/User/Machine), and installation verification result. Missing any required field or non-absolute path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must execute `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version`; command must succeed and stdout must include "4.5.1". Running `godot --version` is optional evidence when PATH is configured; if provided, it must also report "4.5.1". Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `& $env:GODOT_BIN --version` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-bin-version.txt; when `godot --version` is available, its full stdout must be persisted to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/godot-version.txt. Missing required evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

task-0001.json must record command, exit_code, parsed_version, and evidence_file for each Godot version command; missing any key fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

After installing .NET 8 SDK, running `dotnet --version` must start with "8.", and `dotnet --list-sdks` must contain at least one 8.x SDK entry; 7.x, 9.x, empty output, missing 8.x SDK entry, or command failure fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1ToolchainVersionChecksTests.cs

If packages.lock.json is missing before restore, running `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` must generate it; if it already exists, it must remain present and correspond to the same NewRouge.sln restore scope. A lock file outside the NewRouge.sln restore scope does not satisfy acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Before toolchain checks are accepted, `.\NewRouge.sln` must exist in repository workspace and be the exact restore target used in evidence; missing solution file or mismatched restore target fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

Must create logs/ directory structure for evidence, including at minimum logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/, and store readable evidence files covering Godot version checks, dotnet version, dotnet SDK list, packages.lock.json existence, Windows-only result, and UTF-8 result; any missing required directory or evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Acceptance artifacts must explicitly back-link ADR-0031 and ADR-0011 (for example via refs in task-0001.json and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

UTF-8 compliance must be validated at file level: task-0001.json, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md, and generated evidence files under logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/ must decode as UTF-8 without errors; task-0001.json must include utf8_check.result="pass", utf8_check.checked_files (non-empty), and utf8_check.evidence_file. Any decode failure or missing required field fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1EnvironmentEvidencePersistenceTests.cs

Windows-only is a hard gate: os_platform must be Windows, and task-0001.json must include windows_only_check.result="pass" with platform evidence. Non-Windows or missing evidence fails and must stop downstream gates. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1WindowsPlatformGateTests.cs

Must persist full stdout of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln` to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/dotnet-restore.txt; missing evidence file fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs

task-0001.json must include dotnet_restore.command, dotnet_restore.exit_code, and dotnet_restore.evidence_file; dotnet_restore.command must target NewRouge.sln (semantic equivalent of `dotnet restore .\NewRouge.sln`), and dotnet_restore.exit_code must equal 0. Missing any key, wrong restore target, or non-zero exit_code fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task1DotnetRestoreLockfileTests.cs
test_strategy: Check Godot version via 'godot --version', .NET version via 'dotnet --version', and verify packages.lock.json exists. Log environment evidence to logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/env-evidence/. Refs: ADR-0031, ADR-0011.

title: Implement core contracts for offer locking and deterministic outcomes
description: Define contracts for offer locking structure, provenance, and RNG streams per ADR-0032 and Design Gate 05.
acceptance: Contracts layer provides concrete C# types `OfferLockSnapshot` and `OfferProvenance` that can be instantiated in tests; a schema-only or dictionary-only representation does not satisfy this requirement. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

`OfferLockSnapshot` includes `stable_ids`, `display_order`, `provenance`, `rng_stream`, and `locked_at_save_point` semantics (implemented as `IsLockedAtSavePoint`), and `Provenance` remains intact through value-object round-trip serialization/deserialization. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

`OfferProvenance` includes `source_type`, `source_id`, `act`, `floor`, `node_id`, `difficulty`, `rng_stream`, and `stream_pos` with contract-visible field/type definitions that tests can verify. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
In valid constructed samples, `OfferLockSnapshot.rng_stream` equals `OfferProvenance.rng_stream`; any mismatch fails contract validation. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
Offer-lock snapshots preserve `provenance.stream_pos` and explicitly carry save-point lock context as a boolean semantic. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

RNG stream categories are a closed set of `run`, `combat`, `event`, `loot`, `shop`, and `offer`; `OfferLockSnapshot.RngStream` and `OfferProvenance.RngStream` accept only this set, and unknown values fail validation tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RngStreamTypeTests.cs, Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
`stable_ids` are content-stable IDs, and changing only `display_order` does not change the `stable_ids` set. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

`locked_at_save_point` is represented by explicit boolean semantics (`IsLockedAtSavePoint`) and is reproducible for the same lock context; any optional `LockedAt` timestamp is informational only. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs

Serialization/deserialization round-trip preserves full `OfferLockSnapshot` data; identical inputs (including `rng_stream` and `stream_pos`) produce identical outputs, and when `rng_stream` or `stream_pos` changes, `stable_ids` remain content-stable while provenance reflects the changed context. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingDeterminismTests.cs

For identical lock inputs (context, candidates, provenance, save-point flag), deterministic retrieval returns equivalent snapshots for `StableIds`, `DisplayOrder`, `Provenance.RngStream`, `Provenance.StreamPosition`, and `IsLockedAtSavePoint`. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/OfferLockingContractTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests to validate offer locking structure and provenance fields. Test serialization/deserialization for deterministic behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement core contracts for status and modifier system
description: Define contracts for status types (Buff, Debuff, RuleModifier), fields, and deterministic ordering per Design Gate 04.
acceptance: 可通过契约与测试断言验证：StatusType 必须包含 Buff、Debuff、RuleModifier，且必须定义 ExpiresTiming；Status 必须包含 status_id、stacks、duration_turns、source_id、expires_timing、strength 字段；对同一输入集合按 stable_id 排序时，多次执行得到完全一致的顺序；执行驱散后 RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果仍保留。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
对同一初始状态执行同一操作序列时，Status 的叠加、duration_turns 累计与衰减结果必须一致且可断言；当某次操作前置条件不满足时，执行后状态必须与执行前完全一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖叠加规则、持续时长处理、驱散边界（含 RuleModifier 与 strength 不可驱散）以及 stable_id 排序确定性；任一规则被破坏时，至少一个对应测试用例失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
Status 契约必须提供叠加、持续时长累计、衰减三个可调用方法（命名可等价）；每个方法都必须能通过调用后的状态变化（或按规则不变化）直接断言，任一方法缺失、不可访问或不可断言即失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 must be present in task=5 adr_refs of both tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json; any missing or mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs

ADR-0021 and ADR-0029 listed in ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md section "Task5 ADR Mapping" must exactly match task=5 adr_refs in both task views; any mismatch must fail. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
驱散边界必须可观测：当同一集合同时包含可驱散状态与 RuleModifier 或 status.strength 相关效果时，驱散后仅可驱散状态被移除，RuleModifier 与 status.strength 相关效果保持不变；若任一不可驱散效果被移除则判定失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0005AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for status operations: stacking, duration handling, and dispel boundaries. Validate deterministic ordering via stable_id sorting. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0029.

title: Implement core contracts for combat loop and resolution pipeline
description: Define contracts for combat phases, damage calculation, and deterministic sequencing per Design Gates 01 and 03.
acceptance: Deliverables provide executable contracts for four scopes: CombatLoop phases, PlayCard resolution pipeline, damage calculation rules, and the OverplayTax difficulty threshold. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

xUnit contains behavioral assertions for phase transitions, pipeline order and short-circuit behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax threshold behavior, and deterministic execution. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Referenced test files contain executable assertions that prove Task6 contract obligations; stale, missing, or non-executable references fail semantic acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
CombatLoop contract exposes exactly four phases: StartOfTurn, Draw, Main, EndOfTurn; any missing or extra phase fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline contract enforces the exact canonical sequence Validate->ComputeCost->PayCost->BeforePlayTriggers->ResolveEffect->AfterPlayTriggers->MoveCard->DeathCheck, with no missing, extra, or reordered steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Damage contract applies Strength, Weak, and Vulnerable multipliers to mutable damage, and fixed damage remains exempt from mutable multipliers. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
OverplayTax is applied only when difficulty >= 10 and is not applied when difficulty < 10, with explicit boundary assertions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Deterministic ordering uses combatant_id and stable_id to produce stable sequence output, and repeated runs with the same input stay identical. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 test suite includes both positive and negative paths for transitions, pipeline behavior, damage rules, OverplayTax behavior, and deterministic outcomes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
Phase transition guards reject invalid transitions and preserve unchanged combat state when rejection occurs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

Task6 contract behavior must stay consistent with ADR-0021 (state machine boundaries) and ADR-0032 (determinism), and tests must assert that alignment. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0006CombatContractsTraceabilityTests.cs
When Validate fails, pipeline execution stops at Validate and does not execute ComputeCost or later steps, with critical state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
xUnit includes an explicit Validate-failure case asserting that step trace stops at Validate and state remains unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
Tests assert both valid and invalid phase transition behavior, including guard rejection and unchanged state on invalid transitions. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/CombatLoopPhaseTransitionTests.cs
Tests cover the OverplayTax boundary at difficulty 9 and 10 with explicit assertions for not-applied versus applied taxed-cost behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
All deterministic cases produce identical outputs for identical inputs and identical initial state, independent of run count. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Damage coverage executes a representative input matrix that proves multiplier and fixed-damage behavior across scenarios. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

[OBL:T6.O10] Multiplier and fixed-damage scenarios include normal cases, boundary cases, and negative/invalid inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O10] Table-driven damage tests verify multiplier math, fixed-damage invariants, and deterministic numeric outputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop is implemented as an instantiable C# contract type in Game.Core and is directly usable by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] Contract completion requires executable behavior verified by tests, not descriptive-only declarations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T6.O15] CombatLoop implementation is located under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat and referenced by tests. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
PlayCard resolution applies OverplayTax during ComputeCost and consumes the taxed cost in PayCost when difficulty >= 10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
When ComputeCost or PayCost fails, pipeline stops immediately at the failing step and keeps critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

For the same PlayCardPipelineInput and the same initial state, repeated runs produce identical ExecutedSteps, StateAfter, and ExecutionFingerprint. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

When any post-cost step (BeforePlayTriggers, ResolveEffect, AfterPlayTriggers, MoveCard, DeathCheck) fails, execution stops at the failing step and keeps critical combat state unchanged. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs

PlayCard pipeline and damage calculation are defined as explicit executable contract types under Game.Core/Contracts/Combat (or subfolders), and tests reference those contract types directly rather than only service-side implicit behavior. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/ValueObjects/DamageTests.cs

Deterministic sequencing contract defines comparator precedence (combatant_id first, stable_id second) and deterministic tie handling for equal keys, and tests assert this rule explicitly. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
test_strategy: Write xUnit tests for combat phase transitions, damage calculation, and OverplayTax application. Ensure deterministic ordering via combatant_id and stable_id. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0032.

title: Implement save serialization and atomic write
description: Create SaveService serialization, schema versioning, and atomic write.
acceptance: 当保存成功时，SaveService 必须把 schema_version、save_point_id、offer_locks 写入同一保存载荷，并通过“先写临时文件再原子替换目标文件”提交到 user://；提交后读取目标文件必须得到本次写入的完整最新数据。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0012AcceptanceTests.cs
保存仅允许写入 user:// 下合法相对路径；输入绝对路径、越权路径或 traversal-like 路径时必须 fail-fast 返回错误，且目标位置不得产生任何落盘文件。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0012AcceptanceTests.cs
任一持久化步骤失败时，必须向调用方返回带上下文的错误并输出该次持久化要求的证据字段；失败后最近一次有效保存内容必须保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0012AcceptanceTests.cs
序列化载荷必须稳定包含 schema_version、save_point_id、offer_locks 三项字段；读取结果必须可逐项验证字段存在且值可解析。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceSerializationTests.cs
本任务不实现迁移逻辑：遇到旧版本或不兼容数据时，不得自动转换、升级或覆盖既有有效保存。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceVersionGuardTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖序列化往返一致性：写入后再读取时，schema_version、save_point_id、offer_locks 的值与写入前逐项一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceSerializationTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须覆盖原子提交失败路径：提交中断或写入失败时，目标保存文件不得出现部分写入状态，且上一份有效保存仍可读取。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
xUnit must verify atomic commit behavior by writing to a temp file first and replacing the target as one commit outcome. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
xUnit must verify that persistence failure does not leave a partial target-file state. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
xUnit must verify valid user:// relative paths are writable and can be read back after save. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
xUnit must verify absolute paths and traversal-like paths are fail-fast rejected. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
xUnit must verify path validation rejects inputs outside user:// safety boundaries. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
xUnit must verify serialization scope for this task remains the defined run-save payload shape and required fields. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceSerializationTests.cs
Add xUnit cases asserting allowlisted user:// path policy is explicit and auditable. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
Add xUnit cases asserting rejected paths return structured error code and contextual details to the caller. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O9] xUnit 测试必须在同一测试组中同时验证序列化 round-trip 一致性与载荷 shape stability。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/RunAndSaveContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O9] xUnit 测试必须断言 schema_version、save_point_id、offer_locks 字段存在、可解析且键名稳定。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/RunAndSaveContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O9] 必须新增 xUnit 序列化往返测试，并同时验证 required fields 与 shape stability。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/RunAndSaveContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O10] xUnit 测试必须覆盖原子提交成功路径：替换后目标文件为最新完整数据且临时文件被清理。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O10] xUnit 测试必须覆盖提交失败路径：目标文件无部分写入状态且仍可读取上一份有效保存。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O10] 必须新增 xUnit 测试同时验证原子提交 commit behavior 与写失败后无 partial-file。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O11] xUnit 测试必须覆盖 user:// 合法相对路径写入成功。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O11] xUnit 测试必须覆盖绝对路径与 traversal-like 路径 fail-fast 拒绝且不得产生落盘文件。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O11] 必须新增 xUnit 测试覆盖 user:// 合法路径允许与非法路径拒绝两类用例。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServicePathValidationTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O12] xUnit 测试必须断言持久化失败时向调用方传播带上下文错误并包含要求的证据字段。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O12] xUnit 测试必须断言失败后上一份有效保存内容保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
[OBL:T12.O12] 必须新增 xUnit 测试断言失败路径的错误传播与 previous save 不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/SaveServiceAtomicWriteTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for serialization round-trip and atomic write behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Set up Godot autoloads and composition root
description: Configure Godot autoloads (EventBus, DataStore, Logger, etc.) and composition root for dependency injection per project-context.md.
acceptance: 在 Godot 项目中注册且可见的 Autoload 必须包含 EventBus、DataStore、Logger、SecurityAudit、PerformanceTracker、SentryClient、FeatureFlags、CompositionRoot；脚本位置限定在 Game.Godot/Adapters、Game.Godot/Scripts、Game.Godot/Autoloads，且仅承担装配/桥接职责，不包含领域规则计算或状态机分支。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0013_composition_root_acceptance.gd

CompositionRoot 必须在运行时提供 time、input、resourceLoader、dataStore、logger、eventBus 端口可用，且 HasInitializationErrors 返回 false 且 InitializationErrors 为空；CompositionRoot 装配节点在场景生命周期内可解析。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0013_composition_root_acceptance.gd

CompositionRoot 必须在运行时将 core 端口注入到实现注入钩子的 Godot 节点集合（不少于 2 个探针节点）并被节点实际消费；验收需断言节点拿到的 time、input、resourceLoader、dataStore、logger、eventBus 端口引用均为非空，且对未实现注入钩子、注入钩子签名不合法（invalid hook/signature）或钩子内部异常的节点返回失败并记录可观测错误（非静默成功）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0013_composition_root_acceptance.gd

Startup smoke must run the Godot project and verify all required autoloads load without startup errors; if any autoload fails to load or any startup error/fatal appears, acceptance must fail and stop further wiring checks. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0013_composition_root_acceptance.gd

Ensure no domain logic in autoloads: autoload scripts may only perform composition/bridge responsibilities and must not contain domain-rule calculations or state-machine branching; violations must fail acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0013_composition_root_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Run Godot project to verify autoloads load without errors. Write GdUnit4 tests to validate composition root wiring. Refs: ADR-0021, ADR-0022.

title: Create main menu scene with new run and continue options
description: Implement MainMenu.tscn with New Run, Continue (single slot), and Quit buttons per M1 requirements.
acceptance: GdUnit4 验收用例必须通过，且覆盖主菜单按钮交互流程（New Run/Continue/Quit/覆盖确认）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
GdUnit4 用例必须通过，并验证按钮与对话框可见文本来自翻译资源。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
Overlay 08 的 Test-Refs 已包含本任务测试路径且可追溯。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
Game.Godot/Scenes/MainMenu.tscn 必须存在且可加载，运行时可见 New Run、Continue、Quit 三个按钮。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_scene.gd

MainMenu must initialize Continue from the persisted single-slot autosave file: Continue stays disabled when autosave is missing, corrupt, or unparseable, and becomes enabled only for a valid autosave envelope. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_events.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd

存在有效 autosave 时点击 New Run 必须弹出覆盖确认对话框，默认焦点在取消；选择取消时 autosave 保持不变。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_main_menu_new_run_overwrite_cancel.gd Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_confirm_dialog_focus.gd
所有可见文本（按钮与对话框）必须来自翻译资源，界面不得展示硬编码文本。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_translations.gd
点击 Quit 必须触发退出流程并关闭应用，不得无动作停留在主菜单。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_events.gd
必须提供主菜单 UI 流程的手动测试记录，覆盖 New Run 覆盖确认与 Continue 有效 autosave。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
手动测试记录必须可审计（文件或清单可访问）。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
验收项需检查 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0010 的引用或回链。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0014_acceptance.gd
When no valid autosave exists, clicking New Run must start a new run directly and must not open overwrite confirmation dialog. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_events.gd
Continue with a valid autosave must resume the autosave-backed single slot directly and must not present any slot-selection UI. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_main_menu_events.gd

When valid autosave exists and the player confirms overwrite, New Run must start from the overwrite-confirm flow without presenting any slot-selection UI. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_main_menu_new_run_overwrite_cancel.gd
test_strategy: Manual testing of UI flow: new run with overwrite confirm, continue when autosave exists. Write GdUnit4 tests for button interactions and translation loading. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Create modular Act structure for map system
description: Implement map system with modular Act structure, not hardcoded to 3 Acts, per M1 requirements.
acceptance: 地图在Act数量配置为2、4、5时均能完成构建与导航初始化，且不会因固定3个Act假设而失败；自动化验收至少验证一个非3-Act配置通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
在Windows环境执行验收时，地图初始化、节点展示、分叉选择流程均可完成；对同一输入重复执行产生一致的可观察结果，否则判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
Overlay中的Test-Refs可直接定位到本任务的地图导航与Act结构测试文件；若ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST中的对应路径不存在或无法核对通过状态，则判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
Game.Core中的MapService对Act与地图节点进行管理，并在固定输入下可稳定断言节点集合、连接关系与状态变化，且对应xUnit测试通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs
Map.tscn可识别到Combat、Event、Shop、Rest四类节点图标或等价可识别表现；缺失任一类型即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_node_icons_presence.gd
地图支持分叉选择：同一初始状态下选择不同分支后，可达节点集合或后续路径至少存在一处可观察差异；若无差异则判定不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapBranchSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_branch_selection_paths.gd
进入任一节点前必须保存node_pre_enter状态；进入后可通过读取状态或测试断言确认其已保存且与进入前一致，未保存或不一致即判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_node_pre_enter_state.gd
存在xUnit用例验证Act结构可按配置数量运行且不依赖固定3个Act；用例能区分满足条件时成功与不满足条件时失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapActConfigurationTests.cs
存在可重复执行的用例验证地图导航与节点选择，至少覆盖一次有效节点选择及其状态转移结果，并能稳定复现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapNavigationSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_map_navigation_state_transitions.gd
验收材料或变更记录中可检索到ADR-0007与ADR-0021的引用，并能对应到本任务的MapService与地图契约决策；缺失任一引用即判定不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0017_acceptance.gd
[OBL:T17.O8] 在分叉节点提交非法分支ID时，系统必须拒绝该次选择，且当前节点与可达节点集合保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd
[OBL:T17.O8] 对同一非法输入重复执行时结果必须一致，并可通过xUnit或Godot测试断言未发生状态推进。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0017AcceptanceTests.cs

[OBL:T17.O8] 分叉选择接收无效分支输入时必须拒绝前进，且当前导航状态保持不变（must not advance / state unchanged）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/MapServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_fork_invalid_branch_rejected.gd
test_strategy: Test map navigation and node selection. Write xUnit tests for Act structure modularity. Refs: ADR-0007, ADR-0021.

title: Implement reward scene with card three-choice-one and offer locking
description: Create Reward.tscn with three card choices, offer locking, and deterministic display per ADR-0032.
acceptance: 进入 Reward.tscn 后，界面必须同时且仅出现 3 张可选择卡牌；若数量不等于 3 或任一卡缺少名称、描述、形态标识（Base/U1A/U1B/Ultimate）则不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_three_cards_rendered.gd

在同一轮奖励展示内，玩家仅能成功确认 1 张卡牌；首张确认成功后其余 2 张必须立即变为不可确认，且任何后续确认输入都不得产生第二次成功结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_single_confirm_lock.gd Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardSelectionServiceTests.cs

该轮奖励首次展示时必须锁定当前 offer 并写入自动存档；在未生成新 offer 的前提下，退出并重新进入后展示的三卡内容与顺序必须与首次展示一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferLockingServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd
执行“跳过”后 RNG 状态必须不前进；在未生成新 offer 的前提下再次进入奖励界面时，必须仍展示同一组三卡。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferRngStateTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_skip_preserves_offer.gd
奖励界面所有可见文案必须来自翻译资源；若出现任何硬编码业务文案则不通过。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_reward_ui_translations.gd
必须存在 xUnit 用例覆盖 offer 锁定逻辑，并验证退出后再次进入时仍读取并展示同一 offer。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/RewardOfferLockingServiceTests.cs

必须存在覆盖奖励展示、单选确认与跳过流程的验证用例，并包含退出后再次进入仍保持同一 offer 的场景断言。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Reward/test_reward_scene_confirm_and_skip_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_offer_lock_persist_reenter.gd

Task 19 implementation and test artifacts must explicitly trace to ADR-0032 and ADR-0010 (for example in refs fields, checklist mapping, or test annotations); missing either ADR id fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0019_acceptance.gd

Task 19 acceptance must include an auto-checkable ADR linkage gate that verifies ADR-0032 and ADR-0010 are both present and consistent across task evidence; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0019_acceptance.gd
test_strategy: Test reward display, selection, and skip. Verify offer locking by exiting and re-entering. Write xUnit tests for offer locking logic. Refs: ADR-0032, ADR-0010.

title: Implement card drop pools per Act and encounter type
description: Add card pools by act and encounter type with rarity tiers.
acceptance: 对每个已支持的Act与遭遇类型组合，查询时必须返回一个包含稀有度层级的有效卡池；任一组合缺失、返回空结果或缺少稀有度层级即判定不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0029AcceptanceTests.cs
在Windows环境执行任务0029相关验收测试时，测试结果必须全部通过并与任务0029期望断言一致；出现任一失败或断言不一致即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0029AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay的Test-Refs清单已包含本任务对应测试条目，且条目与当前实现一一对应且无失配。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0029AcceptanceTests.cs
每个Act均定义normal/elite/boss/shop/event五类卡池条目并包含稀有度层级；给定Act与遭遇类型时必须可解析到且仅解析到一个对应卡池。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardPoolSelectionTests.cs
OfferService在UI展示卡牌选择时不得推进随机数状态；在相同种子与相同输入状态下重复调用必须返回完全一致的选择结果，若结果差异或RNG状态变化则验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceDeterminismTests.cs
存在可重复通过的xUnit测试，分别验证卡池选择的确定性与稀有度分布稳定性；任一测试不稳定或不通过即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceDeterminismTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Services/CardPoolRarityDistributionTests.cs
Task 29 implementation acceptance must explicitly validate consistency with ADR-0032 and ADR-0033; missing either ADR trace fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0029AcceptanceTests.cs

Task 29 test acceptance must include explicit ADR-0032 traceability check and record pass/fail in task evidence output; missing ADR-0032 gate fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0029AcceptanceTests.cs

OfferService preview must reject unsupported act values and must not advance RNG-related state; after a rejected call, rerunning the same valid input with the same seed and streamPosition must return identical results. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceDeterminismTests.cs

OfferService deterministic preview results must be jointly determined by act and encounterType; with the same seed and streamPosition, changing act or encounterType must produce an observably different selection. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/OfferServiceDeterminismTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for pool selection determinism and rarity distribution stability. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Define relic contracts and instance model
description: Create relic definition/instance contracts in Game.Core/Contracts.
acceptance: Task 30 must include an xUnit acceptance test at Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0030AcceptanceTests.cs, and that test must fail if RelicDefinition lacks any required key (relic_id, name_key, description_key, tags) or if RelicInstance lacks any required key (instance_id, modifiers). Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0030AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境运行该验收测试套件时必须全部通过；测试断言必须证明 RelicDefinition 与 RelicInstance 的契约声明仅位于 Game.Core/Contracts，若在其他目录出现同名契约声明则断言失败 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0030AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单必须包含本任务测试文件路径，并且可由该路径定位到 Task 30 对应验收用例；路径缺失或无法定位即验收失败 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0030AcceptanceTests.cs

在 Game.Core/Contracts 下必须定义名为 RelicDefinition 的契约类型，并公开 relic_id、name_key、description_key、tags 四个字段或属性；缺少任一项即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicDefinitionTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicContractsBoundaryTests.cs

在 Game.Core/Contracts 下必须定义名为 RelicInstance 的契约类型，并公开 instance_id、modifiers 两个字段或属性；缺少任一项即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicInstanceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicContractsBoundaryTests.cs
仓库中除 Game.Core/Contracts 外不得存在 RelicDefinition 或 RelicInstance 的契约定义声明；一旦发现同名契约定义即验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicContractsBoundaryTests.cs

Must include serialization round-trip acceptance: after JSON serialize/deserialize for RelicDefinition and RelicInstance, fields relic_id/name_key/description_key/tags and instance_id/modifiers must remain identical; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0030AcceptanceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicDefinitionTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Domain/RelicInstanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for relic contract validity and serialization. Refs: ADR-0020.

title: Implement autosave triggers per determinism policy
description: Add autosave on combat start, reward screen open, and event choice.
acceptance: 当且仅当发生以下事件时，系统分别立即写入 1 次自动存档：战斗进入初始状态、奖励界面首次显示、事件选择作出后；除这三类触发外不得产生自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
玩家执行跳过/略过流程前后，自动存档计数必须保持不变；跳过/略过流程本身不得新增任何自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 08 验收清单中的 Test-Refs 指向本任务相关测试文件或占位，并与“战斗初始、奖励首次显示、事件选择后触发，跳过不新增”语义一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit 测试必须可观测地覆盖三类自动存档触发时机与存档内容一致性，并验证跳过/略过流程不产生额外自动存档。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Task 36 acceptance must explicitly trace implementation and tests to ADR-0032 and ADR-0023; missing either ADR linkage fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
Gate check must fail when ADR-0032 or ADR-0023 back-link evidence is absent from task-0036 outputs or checklist mapping. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0036AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for autosave timing and content. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Audit logging for determinism and security events
description: Implement JSONL audit logging to logs/ per SSoT.
acceptance: 触发保存、加载、offer lock 或 deny 任一审计事件后，必须在 logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/security-audit.jsonl 产生或追加审计记录，且路径符合 SSoT 规范。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
在 Windows 环境执行相关流程后必须可验证日志写入成功，且 security-audit.jsonl 必须满足 JSONL 约束（每一行都可独立解析为 JSON 对象）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
验收需提供可追溯证据（测试结果或日志文件），并能对应 JSONL 字段与路径校验结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
在 logs/ci/<YYYY-MM-DD>/security-audit.jsonl 中，每条审计记录必须包含 ts、action、reason、target、caller 五个字段，任一字段缺失即不通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
日志必须至少包含保存、加载、offer lock、拒绝四类事件；触发拒绝场景时必须写入对应 deny 事件且包含 reason。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerEventCoverageTests.cs
提供 xUnit 测试校验 JSONL 行结构与目标路径 logs/ci/<date>/security-audit.jsonl；字段缺失、JSON 不可解析或路径错误时测试必须失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
提供 AuditLogger（或同等同名组件）作为审计写入入口，并由该入口生成满足上述字段与路径约束的 JSONL 记录。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
Task 38 artifacts must explicitly trace to ADR-0019 and ADR-0003; missing either ADR reference fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/AuditLoggerJsonlSchemaTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests to verify JSONL schema and file paths. Refs: ADR-0019.

title: Run state machine with Command-only transitions
description: Implement run state transitions via Command entries only.
acceptance: RunStateMachine 在运行时仅通过处理 Command 入口触发运行状态迁移，并有对应可追溯测试覆盖。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境可运行 xUnit；用例可判定命令驱动的迁移顺序与状态不变式是否满足。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 指向本任务测试路径且可追溯。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
给定相同初始状态与相同 Command 顺序，处理后得到的运行状态序列与最终状态必须一致，并可由测试验证。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs
任何对外可观察的运行状态变更只能在处理 Command 时发生；未处理 Command 的调用必须保持运行状态不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateManagerTests.cs
提供可用的 RunStateMachine 与 Command 类型，迁移仅可由 Command 入口触发，并测试至少一个有效迁移与一个无效迁移（无效迁移不得改变状态）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs
xUnit 覆盖命令迁移顺序与状态不变式；当顺序错误或不变式被破坏时，测试必须稳定失败且可复现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateMachineTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/State/GameStateManagerTests.cs
文档或测试用例中明确引用 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0021。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0043AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for command transition ordering and state invariants. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Deterministic resume integration tests (headless)
description: Add GdUnit4 tests for save/resume determinism in reward/shop/event.
acceptance: 提供 headless GdUnit4 集成验收用例，并实际覆盖 reward/shop/event 三类流程的保存/恢复确定性验证；任一流程未覆盖即验收失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd
验收用例可在 Windows headless 模式下无人值守执行并通过；若出现交互窗口或需要人工输入则判定失败。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 明确记录并可追溯到本任务测试路径，且指向路径可定位对应的 headless 验收用例。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd
headless GdUnit4 在 reward、shop、event 各场景执行“保存→退出→重进→恢复”，并断言恢复后 offer lock 状态与选择结果与保存前一致。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd

reward、shop、event 三类流程各至少包含一次可观测断言（状态或事件输出）；任一断言失败时输出可定位场景与字段的失败信息。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_assertion_diagnostics.gd

headless 套件执行后在 logs/e2e/<date>/ 产出可读取的 JUnit/XML 结果文件，且至少包含本任务相关测试用例结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_headless_junit_xml_artifacts.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd

测试全程不依赖交互式窗口或人工输入，并可在 Windows headless 环境重复执行得到一致通过结果。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_headless_resume_repeatability.gd

After headless suite execution, logs/e2e/<date>/ must include readable JUnit/XML and audit logs; audit logs must contain save and resume records for reward/shop/event, and must support per-flow mapping checks where post-resume offer lock and selected result equal pre-save values; any missing flow, field mismatch, or mapping failure fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_reward_shop_event_resume_determinism.gd (anchor: ACC:T44.8)

Task 44 artifacts must explicitly include traceability to ADR-0032 and ADR-0025 (for example in refs fields, test annotations, or checklist mapping); missing either ADR id fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Tasks/test_task0044_acceptance.gd
Acceptance must fail when ADR-0032 or ADR-0025 trace markers are absent from test artifacts or checklist entries. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_adr_trace_markers_gate.gd
test_strategy: Run headless suite and verify JUnit/XML + audit logs. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement stability safeguards for combat loop
description: Add safety limits (100 cards per turn) and failure handling.
acceptance: 当同一回合累计出牌尝试达到第101张时，战斗循环必须立即触发硬上限并进入失败处理路径，且第101张请求返回可断言的失败结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
在Windows环境下，硬上限或失败处理被触发后必须产生至少一种可观察输出（状态、返回值或日志），并可由自动化测试断言。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
验收清单必须能定位到本任务用例索引，且索引可用于核对“超过100张硬停止”与“失败处理”结果。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
当同一回合出牌尝试超过100张时，系统必须立即拒绝后续出牌请求，且回合/战斗状态保持一致并且进程不崩溃。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
触发硬停止时，系统必须写入可查询审计条目，且日志中可确认触发原因为超过单回合100张上限。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
对无效出牌请求，系统必须返回明确失败结果，已确认状态保持不变，且不得抛出未处理异常。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
必须存在xUnit用例，验证“超过100张出牌尝试”会触发硬停止且不会继续处理后续出牌。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
必须存在xUnit用例，断言硬停止路径会产生可检索的审计日志条目。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
实现说明与测试说明必须显式引用ADR-0029，作为硬上限与失败处理依据。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0029"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH02", "CH07"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
本任务 `test_refs` 列出的关键测试与工件必须在本轮执行并输出 `executed/pass_fail` 状态；任一未执行或失败即任务失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
若本任务存在可选开关，未启用时必须记录 `executed=false` 与 `pass_fail="skipped"`，且不得被记为通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0049AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for hard-stop behavior and audit log entries. Refs: ADR-0029.

title: Implement save migration validation and failure blocking
description: Add migration checks and block Continue on invalid save.
acceptance: 读取存档时必须校验 schema_version，并在需要时执行迁移；迁移成功后 Continue 可用；迁移失败时 Continue 必须保持不可用、不得进入游戏流程，且状态不得前进。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs
在 Windows 环境下的 xUnit 用例必须覆盖“迁移失败会阻断 Continue 且错误提示可见”的路径，并可从测试结果直接判定失败分支未进入游戏流程。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs
Overlay 的 Test-Refs 需要指向本任务相关测试文件，以对齐验收清单。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs

Windows xUnit must verify that schema_version migration failure blocks Continue, surfaces an error, and keeps the entry inaccessible until migration succeeds. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs

Task 50 implementation and acceptance must explicitly satisfy ADR-0032 and ADR-0023 constraints; missing either ADR traceability fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs

Review evidence for Task 50 must provide auditable mapping to ADR-0032 and ADR-0023 in test artifacts or checklist refs; missing mapping fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0050AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for migration failure blocking and error paths. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Integrate combat turn flow and persistence
description: Wire combat turn flow to core services and save points.
acceptance: 当流程从非战斗状态进入战斗状态时，核心服务必须触发且仅触发一次起始自动保存；保存存储中必须新增且仅新增一条与该次进入战斗对应的记录。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
每次满足前置条件的回合推进请求都必须经核心服务成功更新回合计数与当前行动者；任一前置条件不满足时必须返回不可推进结果，且回合计数与当前行动者保持推进前值。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
仅当判定达到回合结束条件时才执行回合结束清理，并产生可观测状态变化或事件；未达到条件时不得触发清理，且相关状态保持不变。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
从起始自动保存恢复后，回合计数与当前行动者必须与保存快照完全一致；在恢复态发起一次合法推进后，系统必须进入下一个有效回合状态。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd
必须提供 GdUnit4 用例，至少覆盖进入战斗触发起始自动保存、合法回合推进、以及从起始自动保存恢复后继续推进三条主流程。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd
验收清单必须明确列出上述回合流程与恢复行为对应的 GdUnit4 测试文件路径，并给出每个文件的验证覆盖范围说明。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd
回合结束清理必须通过核心服务执行或由其统一触发；每次清理都必须留下可检索记录或事件，用于持久化核验与流程追踪。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
[OBL:T51.O7] 验收清单必须包含显式映射条目，将起始自动保存、回合推进、回合结束清理逐项关联到 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0025。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs Game.Core.Tests/Contracts/RunAndSaveContractsTests.cs
[OBL:T51.O7] 至少一个测试条目必须明确其验证点覆盖 ADR-0025 约束，且该覆盖点可通过测试说明或命名直接定位。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/CombatServiceTests.cs
[OBL:T51.O7] 验收门禁输出必须显式给出 ADR-0032 与 ADR-0025 的可追溯映射结果；缺失任一 ADR 映射时判定为未通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task51AdrTraceabilityGateTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `adr_refs=["ADR-0032", "ADR-0025"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
门禁汇总必须包含 `chapter_refs=["CH01", "CH06", "CH07", "CH05"]` 且与任务元数据完全一致；缺失或不一致时门禁必须非零退出。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
本任务 `test_refs` 列出的关键测试与工件必须在本轮执行并输出 `executed/pass_fail` 状态；任一未执行或失败即任务失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
若本任务存在可选开关，未启用时必须记录 `executed=false` 与 `pass_fail="skipped"`，且不得被记为通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs
对于任一必填回链字段、测试证据或工件校验缺失，门禁必须 fail-closed 且非零退出，不得降级为 warning。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs

[ACC:T51.5] At least one cross-restart acceptance case must cover the closed loop: turn-end cleanup completed -> save point persisted -> restore -> legal progression continues. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd

[ACC:T51.6] Acceptance must distinguish and assert three save-point semantics separately: combat-entry auto-save, post turn-end cleanup save, and post-restore legal progression; missing any one fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0051AcceptanceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd

[ACC:T51.16] After turn-end cleanup is completed, the resulting persistence markers must be restored consistently across restart (turn_count/current_actor/cleanup markers). Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_savegame_persistence_cross_restart.gd
test_strategy: GdUnit4 tests for turn flow and resume behavior. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Implement enemy intent selection logic
description: Add deterministic intent selection rules per enemy.
acceptance: 在覆盖多个敌人且包含不同战斗状态的样例中，意图选择结果必须由“敌人规则 + 当前战斗状态”共同决定并可断言验证；若同一敌人在不同状态下始终返回同一意图，则验收失败。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
在敌人、RNG流输入、战斗状态三者完全相同的前提下，重复执行意图选择必须得到完全一致结果；当仅RNG流输入或战斗状态任一发生变化时，必须基于新输入重新计算，并在至少一组样例中出现可验证的结果差异。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
必须新增或更新xUnit用例，明确覆盖“同敌人+同输入结果一致”与“输入变化可触发差异”的确定性行为，并在Test-Refs清单中可追溯到对应测试文件。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs

With identical enemy and combat state, changing only RNG stream input must trigger intent recomputation and produce at least one verifiable intent difference across samples; otherwise acceptance fails. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs

With identical enemy and RNG stream input, changing only combat state must trigger intent recomputation and produce at least one verifiable intent difference across samples; otherwise acceptance fails. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
Task 52 acceptance must explicitly trace to ADR-0032 and ADR-0021 in implementation/test evidence; missing either ADR link fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
xUnit acceptance outputs for Task 52 must include ADR-0032 trace fields that CI can audit; missing trace fields fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0052AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: xUnit tests for intent selection determinism. Refs: ADR-0032.

title: Headless smoke runner (Python) + strict mode
description: Implement a Python-first headless smoke runner for Godot on Windows, matching the existing PowerShell behavior. Add an optional strict mode that requires a success marker in logs. Source: docs/migration/Phase-12-Headless-Smoke-Backlog.md (B1/B2).
acceptance: 在 logs/ci/<date>/task-0053.json 记录本任务交付的 headless runner 与 strict 行为摘要（含参数、退出码、产物路径），用于追溯实现。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
在 Windows 环境下运行 smoke_headless.py 的命令、退出码与日志产物路径被写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0053.json，作为 Windows-only 运行证据。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
更新 overlay 的 Test-Refs 清单，覆盖本任务相关测试并指向现有测试路径。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

提供 scripts/python/smoke_headless.py，可在 Windows 运行并支持参数 --godot-bin、--scene、--timeout-sec、--project-path、--strict；参数缺失或无效时返回非零并输出可读错误信息。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
运行后在 logs/ci/<date>/smoke/ 下产出 headless.out.log、headless.err.log、summary.json；三者均存在且包含本次运行信息。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerArtifactsSummaryTests.cs

Strict mode returns 0 only when logs contain either [TEMPLATE_SMOKE_READY] or [DB] opened; otherwise returns non-zero. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerPermissiveModeTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Smoke/test_main_scene_smoke.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Adapters/Db/test_journal_modes_cross_restart.gd
非严格模式允许在缺少成功标记时仍返回 0，但必须生成日志与 summary.json。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerPermissiveModeTests.cs

Timeout and exit-code semantics must stay aligned with the PowerShell headless runner and be validated by the same scenario comparison. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerPermissiveModeTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Smoke/test_main_scene_smoke.gd
本地 Windows 运行已完成，并验证退出码与产物可复核。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
CI headless 已运行并确认 logs/ci/** 归档可复核。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
Acceptance explicitly records ADR Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
Acceptance explicitly records chapter alignment: CH01/CH06/CH07/CH10. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
在 ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 的 Test-Refs 中逐条列出主任务 Test Refs 清单中的具体路径（含 logs/ci/<date>/smoke 与 Tests/...）。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
Local Windows validation must specify and record a known-good scene path; missing known-good scene path fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

The same acceptance record must include run command, exit code, and verification results for all three artifacts (headless.out.log, headless.err.log, summary.json) for the known-good scene run. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Overlay index file `docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/_index.md` must include Task 53 back-link with strict/non-strict behavior and artifact entry points; missing entry fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs

Feature slice file `docs/architecture/overlays/PRD-NEWROUGE-GAME-0001/08/08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md` must include Task 53 Test-Refs and acceptance conclusion aligned with ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md; any mismatch fails acceptance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task53HeadlessRunnerCliValidationTests.cs
test_strategy: Run locally on Windows against a known-good scene and verify exit code + artifacts.
Run in CI headless and confirm logs are archived under logs/ci/**.

title: Integrate GdUnit4 suites into quality_gates.py
description: Extend scripts/python/quality_gates.py to optionally run selected GdUnit4 suites (adapters/security as hard gate, integration/UI as soft gate) and aggregate results into a single summary JSON. Source: docs/migration/Phase-13-Quality-Gates-Backlog.md (B2).
acceptance: 在 Windows 环境运行 quality_gates.py 且启用 GdUnit4 参数时，必须在同次执行记录中看到被选 suite 的执行结果与门禁类型；未启用该参数时，必须将对应 suite 明确标记为未运行，并写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0054.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

在 Windows/PowerShell 下，quality_gates.py 必须能解析并实际执行 GdUnit4 相关参数；脚本退出码必须与总体门禁结论一致（通过=0，失败=非0），并将结果写入 logs/ci/<date>/task-0054.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
Overlay 文档的 Test-Refs 必须覆盖与 GdUnit4 接线相关的验证项，且每一项都能回链到本任务描述或测试策略，避免引入与本任务无关的引用。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

quality_gates.py 必须提供参数以显式选择是否运行 GdUnit4 suites，并在结果中区分 adapters/security 与 integration/UI 两类 suites。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitGatePolicyTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
adapters/security suites 任一失败必须导致总体门禁失败；integration/UI suites 失败仅记录为软门禁，不阻断总体通过。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs
执行后必须生成单一机器可读 summary JSON，包含各 suite 状态、门禁级别与总体门禁结论，并输出到 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json。 Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_gdunit_junit_artifact_export.gd

GdUnit4 的 JUnit/XML 输出必须写入 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml；若未生成该文件，summary 必须明确记录未生成原因。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd

本地分别在开启与关闭 GdUnit4 参数运行 quality_gates.py 时，summary 中 suites 状态必须可区分为已运行与未运行，不能以缺失字段代替。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitSuiteSelectionTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
CI 任务必须以 summary JSON 的总体门禁结论作为 pass/fail 判定依据，且结论变化时 CI 结果同步变化。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs
Test-Refs 列表必须包含 logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json 与 logs/e2e/<date>/gdunit/junit.xml，且路径与实际产物一致。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54GdUnitGatePolicyTests.cs

Test-Refs 列表必须包含 Tests.Godot/tests/ci/test_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd 与 Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task32AcceptanceTests.cs，并可对应到本任务验收项。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54CiDecisionSyncTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_quality_gates_gdunit_suite_wiring.gd
在 ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md 中必须明确列出 ADR-0005、ADR-0011、ADR-0024 作为本任务门禁语义口径引用。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task54QualityGateSummaryTests.cs
test_strategy: Run quality_gates.py locally with and without GdUnit4 flags to verify behavior.
Validate CI job consumes the summary JSON for pass/fail decisions.

title: Coverage thresholds as configurable soft/hard gate
description: Align xUnit coverage thresholds to the blueprint target (lines >= 90%, branches >= 85%) and allow overriding via environment variables. Provide soft/hard gate modes in scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py.
acceptance: In scripts/python/run_dotnet.py and scripts/python/quality_gates.py, default coverage thresholds are lines>=90 and branches>=85, and those defaults must be used when no override environment variables are provided. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

Coverage threshold environment overrides must be resolved and applied in both scripts, and each script must evaluate gates using its effective thresholds so non-default threshold runs are achievable without code changes. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

Both scripts must expose semantically consistent soft/hard gate behavior: for identical measured coverage below effective thresholds, soft returns exit code 0 with warning and hard returns non-zero; when measured coverage meets or exceeds effective thresholds, both return 0. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

A single machine-readable coverage summary contract must be used for CI outputs; emitted summaries at logs/unit/<date>/summary.json and logs/ci/<date>/quality-gates/summary.json must both include measured line/branch coverage, effective thresholds (after env overrides), gate mode, and pass/fail with identical field semantics. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

For the same environment overrides, run_dotnet.py and quality_gates.py must resolve equivalent effective threshold values (lines/branches) before gate evaluation. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs

Gate-mode selection semantics must remain consistent between run_dotnet.py and quality_gates.py for identical measured/effective coverage inputs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task55CoverageScriptEntrypointBindingTests.cs
test_strategy: Run dotnet tests on Windows and verify threshold behavior by temporarily setting env vars.

title: Audit JSONL validation + gate integration
description: Add a Python validator for security audit JSONL outputs and integrate it into the quality gates flow.
acceptance: Provide scripts/python/validate_audit_logs.py that validates security-audit JSONL line by line for JSON structure and required fields; any invalid line must cause a non-zero exit and the validation result must not be reported as passed. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs

When validation fails, the output must include the exact failing line number and an actionable fix reason so the broken row can be repaired directly. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs

When audit validation is enabled, quality_gates.py must invoke the audit validator and persist the actual executed/pass_fail result into the task-0056 summary JSON. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs

If audit validation is enabled and validate_audit_logs.py fails, quality_gates.py must persist task-0056 summary with audit_validation.executed=true and pass_fail="fail" before exiting non-zero to block downstream release flow. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0056AcceptanceTests.cs, Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
Provide valid and invalid JSONL fixtures and reproduce one passing run and one failing run on Windows. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs

When audit validation is disabled, quality_gates.py must not invoke validate_audit_logs.py and must write executed=false and pass_fail="skipped" into task-0056 summary. Refs: Tests/CI/AuditLogs/ValidateAuditLogsTests.cs
test_strategy: Use valid/invalid JSONL fixtures to reproduce one pass and one fail run on Windows.

title: Traceability gate for ADR/Chapter/Overlay links
description: Split from T56: enforce ADR, chapter, and overlay Test-Refs traceability as a dedicated gate task.
acceptance: task-0057-traceability.json must record pass/fail results for ADR-0019, ADR-0003, and ADR-0005 trace checks. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
task-0057-traceability.json must record pass/fail results for chapter trace checks CH02, CH03, and CH07. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Overlay files _index.md, 08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md, and ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md must all contain searchable T56/T57 Test-Refs entries. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Any ADR/chapter/overlay trace mismatch must fail the traceability gate with non-zero exit and block downstream release steps. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Traceability output must include machine-readable missing/mismatch diff items with concrete file/key locations. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
Traceability check must run on Windows and output platform=windows in task-0057-traceability.json. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

On Windows, the traceability check test strategy must run one pass sample and one fail sample: the pass sample exits 0 with no mismatch diff entries, and the fail sample exits non-zero with mismatch diff entries. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs must cover ADR/chapter/overlay checks and assertions must match task-0057-traceability.json pass/fail and diff output. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Traceability gate must run as a dedicated CI job or dedicated command; if this gate is skipped, unrecognized, or not executed, pipeline must fail before release stages. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Gate must explicitly validate consistency across tasks.json ADR/chapter refs and overlay Test-Refs anchors (bidirectional): missing or mismatched links in either direction must fail with non-zero exit. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Traceability gate must validate full linkage consistency among task adr_refs/chapter_refs/overlay_refs and overlay 08 Test-Refs anchors (_index.md, 08-Feature-Slice-M1-Warrior.md, ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md); any missing, stale, or mismatched link must fail with non-zero exit and emit machine-readable diffs. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Validator must parse and compare these exact fields for Task 57: tasks.json master.adrRefs/chapterRefs/overlay, tasks_back.json and tasks_gameplay.json adr_refs/chapter_refs/overlay_refs, and overlay 08 Test-Refs entries; the consistency scope must include ADR refs, chapter refs, overlay refs, and Test-Refs path anchors. Any mismatch or missing item in this scope must fail gate with non-zero exit and JSON diff evidence. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

必须校验 ADR / 章节 / Overlay Test-Refs 一致性：对比 tasks.json 与 tasks_back.json/tasks_gameplay.json 以及 overlay 文档中的 Test-Refs，任一缺失、错链、过期链接都必须判定失败并输出 diff。 Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

The dedicated validator must compare all required link domains declared by the task metadata against overlay documents, emit JSON diff entries for every missing/stale/mismatched link, and return non-zero when any diff exists. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs

Dedicated checker must validate ADR refs, chapter refs, and overlay Test-Refs links across task metadata and overlay documents, emit machine-readable diffs for every missing/stale/mismatched link, and return non-zero when any mismatch exists. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task57TraceabilityGateTests.cs
test_strategy: Run traceability check on Windows with one pass sample and one fail sample.

title: Semantic scope governance for soft review stabilization
description: Create a governance guardrail that keeps semantic soft review bounded to task scope while preserving deterministic hard-gate precedence.
acceptance: task-0058-semantic-governance.json must include semantic_policy_mode, gate_precedence, and governance_result fields with non-empty values. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs

Policy evaluation scope must be limited to task.master.details and task.mapped.acceptance: when master.details is non-empty, task_context.allowed_scope_items must include both; when master.details is empty, task_context.allowed_scope_items must include only "task.mapped.acceptance". Any scope expansion beyond allowed_scope_items must be classified as advisory out-of-scope and must not become blocker without explicit elevation rule. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs

When acceptance_check is ok and llm_review has warn-level findings only (without explicit elevation), governance_result must be pass and advisory notes must be recorded. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs
When acceptance_check fails, governance_result must be fail regardless of llm_review output. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs
Governance output must expose machine-readable blocker_findings and advisory_findings fields using stable key names. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs
Windows execution evidence in task-0058-semantic-governance.json must include platform=windows and a non-empty run_id. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs

One pass sample and one advisory-warning sample must both be reproducible via local scripts without manual file edits, and each generated task-0058-semantic-governance.json must include machine-readable evidence_refs.acceptance_check_summary and evidence_refs.llm_review_summary paths pointing to logs/ci/<date>/sc-acceptance-check-task-<id>/summary.json and logs/ci/<date>/sc-llm-review-task-<id>/summary.json. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs

If any llm_review finding is explicitly elevated to blocker, output must include elevation_rule_id and supporting evidence and the finding must appear in blocker_findings; without an explicit elevation rule, warn findings must remain in advisory_findings and must not fail governance. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs

Given identical acceptance_check, llm_review, and task context inputs, policy evaluation must produce stable governance_result and identical blocker/advisory classification across repeated runs (review oscillation guard). Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs

For both pass sample and advisory-warning sample, generated evidence summaries must include non-empty status, task_id, generated_at, and findings/summary counters. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task58SemanticScopeGovernanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Run governance evaluation on Windows with one pass sample and one advisory-warning sample, then validate JSON evidence shape and linkage fields.

title: Upgrade Map route graph visualization on top of existing route ownership
description: Track the M1 route-graph guardrail as an upgrade on top of the existing route-owned Map flow so visual route connections, legal edge state, and legacy shortcut suppression remain explicit in backlog and quality gates.
acceptance: On M1 Map, the player-facing entry presents a connected route graph with visible legal-transition edges, continues to use the existing route-owned Map-to-node transition flow, does not present the four standalone node-type shortcut buttons as the primary entry path, and does not introduce any parallel Map-to-node transition owner or second execution path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

The M1 route graph must expose a deterministic directed edge set for the full five-floor route: every non-terminal node has at least one legal outgoing edge to the next floor, the final node has no outgoing edge, and no edge skips floors or points to an undefined node ID. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

Map rendering makes reachable, locked, completed, and selected-path states visually distinguishable on both nodes and edges so currently legal choices are directly observable. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

Selecting a reachable node triggers the existing route-owned Map-to-node transition; selecting a locked or disconnected node shows visible refusal feedback, does not transition, and keeps run progression unchanged. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

After node completion, route-graph reachability updates so only legal next-floor nodes and connecting edges become reachable, while traversed segments remain visible as completed path history. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

When route-graph entry is active, legacy ActionRow shortcut buttons (Combat, Event, Shop, Rest) are hidden or removed from the player-facing Map. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

Route-node selection must have a single execution authority: reachable-node selection resolves exactly once through the existing route-owned transition path, while locked/disconnected selections resolve to refusal feedback only and never invoke an alternative scene transition path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Map/test_map_tree_route.gd

Workflow-selection gate evidence for T70 must be recorded before implementation evidence is accepted; verification must assert a concrete workflow-selection summary artifact exists with task_id=70 and that its timestamp is not later than the selected implementation evidence timestamp. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0070AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Extend the existing Map route GdUnit suite to cover connected route graph edges, path-state visualization, legal unlock progression, and hidden legacy shortcut buttons on Windows.

title: Consolidate combat deck lifecycle wiring as the umbrella task for T80-T82
description: Track the combat deck-lifecycle umbrella milestone over T80-T82 so backlog and quality gates treat this work as an integration checkpoint over existing deck/runtime capabilities, not as a separate build track.
acceptance: T80 is accepted only when evidence from the shared DeckService/CardState runtime path shows deterministic combat deck-lifecycle outcomes for draw-pile-to-hand draw, turn-end discard into discard pile, exhaust-pile placement, and discard-to-draw reshuffle ordering. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

T81 is accepted only when Combat scene/HUD wiring remains synchronized with runtime transitions for draw, hand, discard, and exhaust states, and scene code is limited to binding/orchestration without taking scene-local deck-lifecycle ownership or duplicating lifecycle logic. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

T82 can close this umbrella milestone only when Windows-run evidence from existing deck-lifecycle and Combat scene suites aggregates T80 and T81 results; introducing a fourth parallel implementation path or standalone duplicate track fails acceptance. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

The aggregated T80-T82 milestone evidence must explicitly verify hand state, exhaust pile, turn-end discard behavior, deterministic ordering, and Windows-backed execution, in addition to draw/discard/reshuffle behavior and HUD synchronization. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

T71 remains milestone-only: validation must run through existing DeckService and Combat scene suites, and acceptance fails if a replacement verification lane or a fourth implementation path is used. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Services/DeckServiceTests.cs Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

No implementation evidence under this task is valid unless workflow selection of T71 is recorded first, and the review evidence set must include that selection record before implementation evidence. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0071WorkflowSelectionEvidenceTests.cs
test_strategy: Validate this milestone by aggregating T80-T82 evidence from existing DeckService and Combat scene suites; do not add a separate implementation-only test slice under T71.

title: Bind CombatScene to existing data-driven card definitions and localized card text
description: Track CombatScene binding to existing card definitions, translations, and effect contracts so data-driven card behavior does not fork into a second card model.
acceptance: When CombatScene renders playable cards, each card button shows localized card name, cost, card type, and player-visible effect summary sourced from the existing card-definition and translation contracts, with no hard-coded scene text and no parallel card text/model source. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

Playing any damage, block, status, or mixed-effect card resolves strictly from its existing card definition (including cost payment, targeting rule, and exhaust/discard routing); for each effect component, only definition-allowed targets are mutated and non-target entities remain unchanged, and resulting HP, block, energy, and pile states match that definition. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

Each successful card play emits visible player-facing feedback that matches the resolved outcomes, including damage dealt, block gained, statuses applied, and whether the card was exhausted or discarded. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

If play is rejected due to insufficient energy, missing card definition, or invalid targeting rule, the UI presents refusal feedback and leaves HP, block, energy, and pile states unchanged. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

On the M1 combat surface, both en and zh-CN must render localized card name and localized card body/effect description for playable cards (including Strike and Defend) from the existing translation + card-definition contracts, with visible cost/type data from the same existing definition path; raw localization keys or placeholder text are not allowed. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

CombatScene reads card type from existing card definitions and uses that type for combat presentation and interaction behavior, without hard-coded fallback typing or any parallel card-description path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

When a status card is played, the defined status is applied to the correct target, and when an exhaust-effect card is played, that card is moved to exhaust (not discard) per the existing definition path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

CombatScene card loading uses only existing contracts and current card data files, and does not introduce any new card-definition path or new card-data file family. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

Legacy hard-coded Strike/Defend UI/effect wiring is removed from CombatScene runtime behavior: rendering, cost display, targeting, and resolution for Strike/Defend must come from the same existing card definition + localization + effect contracts path as all other cards, without card-specific hard-coded branches. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

Before workflow selection evidence marks Task 72 as selected, CombatScene implementation changes for this task must not be executable/claimed as delivered; once selected, implementation evidence must trace to the same existing card-definition + localization + effect-contract path (no parallel model path). Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs

For target-rule edge cases (self-only, enemy-only, and invalid selected target), CombatScene must apply or refuse strictly per existing card targeting contracts, with refusal feedback and unchanged state on invalid selection. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_feedback_log.gd Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0072AcceptanceTests.cs
test_strategy: Extend Combat scene binding and feedback suites to cover data-driven card definitions, localized text, effect summaries, and refusal paths.

title: Upgrade existing combat targeting and victory routing to multi-enemy runtime state
description: Track the upgrade from the current single-target or partial targeting skeleton to route-owned multi-enemy combat state, without replacing existing victory-route ownership.
acceptance: In multi-enemy runtime state, Combat must expose every living legal runtime enemy as a selectable and inspectable target entry, and each exposed enemy must surface name, HP, block, status, and intent. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

Card play must enforce legal targeting: single-target cards resolve only when a living legal enemy is selected, and on success the effect applies to the selected enemy only; non-selected enemies must remain unchanged unless the card explicitly declares all-enemy/global behavior, while self-target and all-enemy cards resolve without selecting an enemy. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

If the selected target is invalid, dead, locked, or disconnected, card play must be rejected with visible feedback, and HP, energy, and pile state must stay unchanged. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd

When an enemy dies, it must be removed from the legal target set, and the remaining enemies must keep deterministic combat state with intent still visible. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

After all enemies are defeated, combat completion must remain route-owned and must transition to Reward or Map based on current node rules. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd

Combat victory routing must not trigger while any legal living enemy remains; route-owned completion may execute only after the legal living enemy set becomes empty. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Integration/test_m1_visible_text_flow.gd

If the currently selected enemy becomes dead, disconnected, or otherwise illegal before card resolution, Combat must clear or deterministically retarget selection and must never resolve card effects against an illegal target. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
test_strategy: Extend Combat and targeting flow suites to cover legal target resolution, invalid target refusal, enemy death, and combat completion routing.

title: Upgrade existing targeting flow with Slay-the-Spire-style card drag UX
description: Track drag targeting as an input-layer upgrade over the current validated play path, while preserving the existing accessibility fallback.
acceptance: Dragging a card from hand onto a legal target and releasing it must issue the play request through the current validated card-play path (the same path used by click-based play). Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd

While a dragged card is hovering a legal target, the UI shows a visible target highlight/preview, and no combat state change is applied before release. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd

Dropping on an invalid target or empty area does not commit play: visible invalid/cancel feedback is shown, the card returns to hand, and energy plus pile state remain unchanged. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Battle/test_battle_card_targeting_drag_play_flow.gd

The click path and Play Selected Card accessibility path both remain usable, and a successful legal activation is behaviorally equivalent to a successful legal drag release through the same play flow. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
Drag preview and target-hover interactions are UI-only and must not advance combat RNG streams or route progression. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/UI/test_card_drag_target_play.gd

Keyboard fallback and controller fallback must each complete target selection and play via the same validated card-play path as drag release, without introducing a separate combat input stack. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

Implementation for this task proceeds only after workflow explicitly selects T74, and review evidence includes that workflow-selection record before implementation evidence. Refs: Game.Core.Tests/Tasks/Task0074WorkflowSelectionEvidenceTests.cs
test_strategy: Promote existing drag-target harness coverage into real Combat scene behavior tests, including valid drop, invalid drop, cancel, and accessibility fallback.

title: Wire existing status contracts and rules into visible combat status effects
description: Track combat status visibility as wiring of existing status contracts and rule semantics into the player-facing combat runtime, rather than a duplicate status implementation.
acceptance: When player or enemy statuses are active in combat (including strength, weak, vulnerable, block, poison, and temporary modifiers), each active status is shown on the combat surface with a readable label, visible stack/value, and decision-useful tooltip/detail text, and no active status is omitted. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd

Given the same initial combat state and action sequence, damage and mitigation results are identical across repeated runs, and contributions from strength, weak, vulnerable, block-like effects, poison ticks, and temporary modifiers come from the existing status/modifier rule path. Refs: Tests.Godot/tests/Scenes/Combat/test_combat_scene_ui_bindings.gd
